subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Although he was sincere and hard-working, / he could not confront / his boss manly.

options.text: Although he was sincere and hard-working

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence "Although he was sincere and hard-working, he could not confront his boss manly", the word **'manly' **is an error.
 
• The term **'manly' **is an adjective used to describe characteristic usually associated with men, often connected with strength or bravery. It can't modify a verb, as in the sentence here.
 
• The correct term should be **'manfully' **which is an adverb and can modify **'confront'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 3"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Many adjectives in English automatically form adverbs when **'-ly' **is added at the end. However, beware of certain irregular ones where the adjective is different from the adverbial form. **"Manly" vs "manfully" **is a perfect example of this.
